readback.body: Surgical Jain 8.0.1 identity and governed-proof successor over exact protected main. Product/model/LFS bytes, public API, dependencies, and registry lock entries are unchanged. Local required passed the full Rust suite, 10 LFS OID/materialized checks, the 150-second Prime/Lime differential, target-encoder parity, Starlight golden proof, and both Chimera real-weight CPU smokes. Security, zero public-API drift, real source-plus-LFS artifact evidence, 2/2 coverage sources, full score 88, and changed-fast 86 pass. Existing tags remain immutable; published exact-head required, independent review, approval, merge, next-unused split.1 tag, and authority binding remain.
